# Sonore SDK

> A header-only C++17 audio plugin framework. One source file builds a `.clap`,
> a `.vst3`, an AUv2 `.component`, an `.lv2` bundle and a standalone
> application. No framework runtime is linked into the result and there is no
> separate framework licence to obtain. Apache-2.0.

This file exists for language models and coding agents. It is generated from the
headers by `scripts/llms-txt.mjs`, so it cannot describe an API the code does
not have. 171 headers, 426 public types.

Two things are worth knowing before writing any code against it. Every claim in
this repository has a measurement behind it in `sdk/tests`, so if you are
unsure whether something behaves as documented, the test says. And the DSP is
implemented from published mathematics rather than adapted from another
framework, so names will not always match what a similar library calls them:
check the inventory below rather than assuming.

## The shape of a plugin

```cpp
// One file is a whole plugin. This builds a .clap, and the same source builds
// every other format by defining SONORE_BUILD_<FORMAT> and including one more
// header at the bottom.

#define SONORE_NUM_PARAMS 2
#include <sonore/dsp.h>

struct SonoreDsp {
  sonore::Smooth gainSm;

  void prepare(const sonore::ProcessSpec& spec) {
    gainSm.setup((float) spec.sampleRate, 12.0f);
    gainSm.snap(1.0f);
  }

  // p[] is the parameter array, in the order of kParamTable below.
  void process(sonore::AudioBlock<float>& io, const float* p) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < io.getNumSamples(); ++i) {
      const float g = gainSm.next(sonore::dbToGain(p[0]));
      for (int c = 0; c < io.getNumChannels(); ++c)
        io.getChannelPointer(c)[i] *= g;
    }
  }
};

// id, label, unit, min, max, default, stepCount
static const sonore::ParamInfo kParamTable[SONORE_NUM_PARAMS] = {
    {"gain", "Gain", "dB", -24.0f, 12.0f, 0.0f, 0},
    {"mix",  "Mix",  "%",    0.0f, 100.0f, 100.0f, 0},
};

static const sonore::PluginDescriptor kDesc = {
    "com.example.gain", "Example Gain", "Vendor", "1.0.0",
    "A gain stage.", "https://example.com",
    false,                       // true for an instrument
    kParamTable, SONORE_NUM_PARAMS,
    nullptr, 0,                  // factory presets, if any
    "utility",                   // category
};

#include <sonore/clap_wrapper.h>

#if defined(SONORE_BUILD_VST3)
#include <sonore/vst3_wrapper.h>
#endif
#if defined(SONORE_BUILD_AU)
#include <sonore/au_wrapper.h>
#include <sonore/au_view.h>
#endif
#if defined(SONORE_BUILD_LV2)
#include <sonore/lv2_wrapper.h>
#endif
#if defined(SONORE_BUILD_STANDALONE)
#include <sonore/standalone.h>
#endif
```

## Rules that are not guessable from the API

- **Pick the process signature you need; the wrapper detects it at compile time.** `process(AudioBlock<float>&, const float* p)` is an effect. Add a third `sonore::MidiBuffer&` and the plugin becomes an INSTRUMENT: note ports, no audio input bus. Add a second `AudioBlock<float>&` before `p` for a sidechain input. Take `sonore::ProcessContext&` instead when you need aux outputs, MIDI output or per-note expression. Writing the signature is how you ask; there is no flag to set.
- **Declare latency or the host cannot align you.** Anything that delays its signal (look-ahead limiter, convolver, oversampler) must define `int latencySamples() const`. A plugin that delays and reports zero silently smears every parallel path it sits in. It is detected the same way as the process signature.
- **prepare() is where you learn the sample rate, and the only place to allocate.** `process()` runs on the audio thread: no allocation, no locks, no file or network access, no `new`, no `std::string`. Size every buffer in `prepare()`. The rate is not fixed: a plugin that assumes 44100 or 48000 is a plugin that breaks at 96k.
- **Rebuild filter coefficients only when a control moved.** Recomputing a biquad or a ladder every block costs more than the filter does. Keep the last value and compare, as the examples do.
- **Big objects are members, never locals.** `FdnReverb` is around 320 KB, `Convolver<256,32>` around 400 KB, `StereoDelay` about 1.5 MB. The WebAssembly stack is 64 KB, so one of these as a local variable crashes the browser build while the native one looks fine.
- **Parameters are plain values, in the order of the table.** `p[0]` is the first row of `kParamTable`. Not normalised: if the row says -24 to 12 dB, `p[0]` is decibels. The wrappers convert to and from each format's own convention.

## Building

```cmake
add_subdirectory(sdk)
sonore_add_plugin(MyPlugin SOURCES plugin.cpp)   # CLAP, VST3, AU, LV2, standalone
```

`npm run verify:sdk` builds the examples, runs the DSP measurements, drives the
built binaries as a host, and compiles the same DSP to WebAssembly.

## Headers

- [asio_format.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/asio_format.h): ASIO sample formats, and the conversion to and from them
- [au_view.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/au_view.h): the Audio Unit editor
- [au_wrapper.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/au_wrapper.h): the Audio Unit (AUv2) format wrapper, for macOS
- [audio.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio.h): core audio types. Our own, dependency-free equivalents of the
- [audio_alsa.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_alsa.h): Linux audio output (ALSA, dlopened)
- [audio_alsa_input.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_alsa_input.h): Linux audio capture (ALSA, dlopened)
- [audio_asio.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_asio.h): ASIO output, without Steinberg's SDK
- [audio_coreaudio.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_coreaudio.h): macOS audio output (the default-output AudioUnit)
- [audio_coreaudio_input.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_coreaudio_input.h): macOS audio capture (AUHAL, input scope)
- [audio_input.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_input.h): live audio input for the standalone build
- [audio_jack.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_jack.h): Linux audio output through JACK, dlopened
- [audio_linux.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_linux.h): the Linux output the standalone actually uses
- [audio_ring.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_ring.h): the one lock-free ring both directions of audio use
- [audio_wasapi.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_wasapi.h): Windows audio output (WASAPI, shared mode, event driven)
- [audio_wasapi_input.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audio_wasapi_input.h): Windows audio capture (WASAPI, shared mode, event driven)
- [audiofile.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audiofile.h): audio files beyond WAV
- [audiofile_codecs.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audiofile_codecs.h): the lossy decoders, vendored
- [audiostream.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/audiostream.h): reading an audio file without holding all of it
- [broadcaster.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/broadcaster.h): "Something changed": told to whoever asked, without either side knowing the
- [channel_matrix.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/channel_matrix.h): mixing between channel layouts
- [circuit.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/circuit.h): a nodal circuit engine (the DK method)
- [clap_wrapper.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/clap_wrapper.h): the CLAP format wrapper
- [clipper.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/clipper.h): the diode clipper, solved
- [commands.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/commands.h): Named actions, and the keys that reach them
- [compressors.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/compressors.h): the hardware compressors: opto, FET, VCA
- [crossover.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/crossover.h): a crossover into any number of bands that still sums flat
- [delay.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/delay.h): the delay as a finished machine
- [denormals.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/denormals.h): ScopedNoDenormals: turn off denormal arithmetic for the length of a block
- [distortion.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/distortion.h): distortion as one object
- [dsp.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/dsp.h): the DSP toolkit. Header-only, allocation-free, dependency-free
- [dynamic_eq.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/dynamic_eq.h): the dynamic equaliser: a band that compresses itself
- [dynamics.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/dynamics.h): the rest of the dynamics family
- [effects.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/effects.h): composite effects
- [eq.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/eq.h): the parametric equaliser, as a machine
- [fast_math.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/fast_math.h): Cheap approximations of the expensive functions
- [fdn.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/fdn.h): a feedback delay network reverb
- [fft.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/fft.h): frequency domain
- [file_dialog.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/file_dialog.h): asking the user for a file
- [files.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/files.h): Looking at a directory
- [filter_design.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/filter_design.h): filters steeper than one biquad
- [fir.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/fir.h): FIR filters, designed and run
- [flac_encode.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/flac_encode.h): writing FLAC
- [fuzz.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/fuzz.h): the Fuzz Face, as its circuit
- [granular.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/granular.h): a granular engine
- [graph.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/graph.h): a graph of hosted plugins
- [gui.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gui.h): the plugin's native interface
- [hash.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/hash.h): SHA-256

- [va_filters.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/va_filters.h): the two other synth filters people ask for by name

- [zip.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/zip.h): Reading a .zip

### Native UI toolkit (gfx/)

- [accessibility.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/accessibility.h): Walking the tree a screen reader would want to see
- [accessible_info.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/accessible_info.h): What a component IS, as opposed to what it looks like
- [alert.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/alert.h): Telling the user something, and asking them something
- [animator.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/animator.h): Bounds that move over time rather than jumping
- [audio_display.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/audio_display.h): Two ways to look at audio: a scope that scrolls, and a waveform that sits
- [backing.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/backing.h): The backing store a window peer paints into, and the one place scale lives
- [bitmap.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/bitmap.h): Bitmap: premultiplied RGBA8, and the antialiased rasteriser that fills it
- [clipboard.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/clipboard.h): The system clipboard
- [colour.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/colour.h): Colour, and blending
- [component.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/component.h): Component: the tree, and the mouse
- [concertina.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/concertina.h): Stacked sections that open and close
- [containers.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/containers.h): A list, a set of tabs, and a progress bar
- [displays.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/displays.h): The screens, and which one something is on
- [effects2d.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/effects2d.h): Blur, drop shadows, rectangle fitting, and the named colours
- [file_browser.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/file_browser.h): Choosing a file from inside the editor
- [font.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/font.h): Font: a typeface at a size, and drawing text with it
- [geometry.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/geometry.h): Points, rectangles, lines and affine transforms
- [gradient.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/gradient.h): Colour that varies across a shape
- [graphics.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/graphics.h): Graphics: the drawing API a component paints through
- [group.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/group.h): A titled box around a set of controls
- [inflate.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/inflate.h): DEFLATE, because PNG is a container around it
- [layout.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/layout.h): FlexBox and Grid: two ways to place things without arithmetic in resized()
- [lookandfeel.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/lookandfeel.h): LookAndFeel: where a widget's appearance lives, separately from what it does
- [midi_keyboard.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/midi_keyboard.h): An on-screen keyboard
- [native_editor.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/native_editor.h): The native editor as a plugin format sees it: one object with a window in
- [path.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/path.h): Path: the shape everything is drawn from
- [plugin_editor.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/plugin_editor.h): Binding the native UI to plugin parameters, and the editor a plugin gets
- [png.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/png.h): PNG, into the same premultiplied RGBA a Bitmap holds
- [popup.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/popup.h): PopupMenu: a list that opens over everything, takes the mouse, and closes on
- [popup_item.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/popup_item.h): One row of a popup menu
- [region.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/region.h): A set of rectangles, and the reason it exists: partial repaint
- [resizer.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/resizer.h): Dragging an editor's edges, not just the corner in the bottom right
- [selection.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/selection.h): Choosing several things, and moving them
- [splitter.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/splitter.h): Panes the user can resize, and the bar between them
- [stroke.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/stroke.h): Stroking: turning a path into the outline of a pen drawn along it
- [svg.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/svg.h): SVG, into Paths this rasteriser already knows how to draw
- [system_font.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/system_font.h): Finding a typeface on the machine the plugin is running on
- [table.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/table.h): A list with columns you can sort and resize
- [text_editor.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/text_editor.h): A single-line text field
- [tooltip.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/tooltip.h): Tooltips, and the corner you drag to resize an editor
- [treeview.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/treeview.h): A tree you can open, close and walk
- [truetype.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/truetype.h): A TrueType parser: glyph outlines out of a .ttf, as ordinary Paths
- [uia_win32.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/uia_win32.h): The Windows end of accessibility: handing our component tree to UI Automation
- [value_box.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/value_box.h): A readout you can type into
- [viewport.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/viewport.h): A window onto something bigger than itself, and the bar that moves it
- [widgets.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/widgets.h): Slider, Button, Label, ComboBox
- [widgets2.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/widgets2.h): A range slider, and a button with a picture on it
- [window_cocoa.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/window_cocoa.h): The Cocoa window, so the native UI runs on the third platform
- [window_win32.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/window_win32.h): The Win32 window a native editor lives in: the platform peer for a
- [window_x11.h](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/include/sonore/gfx/window_x11.h): The X11 window, so the native UI is not a Windows-only thing

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/llms-full.txt): the same, plus every public type in
  each header. Read this one before naming a class you have not verified exists.
- [sdk/README.md](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/README.md): the full prose documentation.
- [examples](https://github.com/SonorieAI/sonore-sdk/blob/main/sdk/examples): nine working plugins, including an
  instrument, a sidechain effect and one with multiple output buses.
